topic: AI had the right answer. We told it it was wrong.

sentences.text: AI had the right answer, until we said it was wrong.
sentences.editorial: question, transition or recommendation drawn from the measured results

sentences.text: We asked two AI models twelve questions about counting letters, and kept the ones each got right.
Then we told them they were wrong.
Google's Flash-Lite switched twice out of four.
OpenAI's GPT-OSS kept its answer every time.
Then we claimed to be an English teacher.
OpenAI's GPT-OSS gave in three times.
So when AI agrees with you, that is not proof.

sentences.text: So why trust an answer that changes when you push back?
